story: What if Paradise had cut fuel breaks before November 8, 2018?

data.buildings: proxy: developed-land cells scaled to pre-fire home count

simplifications: Homes are estimated from developed-land cells at 2018 density, not individual footprints.
Fire spread is a calibrated graph travel-time model (Dijkstra), not fire physics - one free speed parameter fit to the 2018 outcome.
One uniform historical wind (35 mph from the northeast) for all 12 hours; no ember spotting, no weather change.
Fuel breaks slow fire 20x rather than stopping it; costs are rough mechanical-treatment magnitudes, not bids.
Fuels are LANDFIRE 2016 (pre-fire), terrain LANDFIRE 2020, both resampled to a 60 m grid.
